firstScreen.notes: qa/screens/1440x900-first.png: h1 readable at 0ms, phone in header, CTA above fold, street-sign marker visible. Trade + city + action clear within 5 seconds. No regression from round 1.

distinctiveness.notes: qa/screens/1440x900-full.png: walking path SVG connectors now visually realize the neighborhood walk thesis. Split-layout and card-grid break sign-rail monotony. Street-sign system unique in niche. Palette distinct from siblings.

type.notes: qa/screens/390x844-first.png: Aleo/Figtree/DM Mono system effective. H1 clamp works. Sign blade typography clear. No regressions.

layout.notes: qa/screens/1440x900-full.png: eleven sections plus walking-path connectors. Tone sequence passes rhythm rules. Highlands split-layout integrates honest-limits. Crescent Hill card-grid breaks list pattern. Layout variety sufficient.

photo.notes: qa/screens/1440x900-full.png: placeholder mode. Captions accurate. No faces/logos/house numbers. Grade filter consistent. Cannot improve without real media.

copy.notes: dist/index.html: voice consistent, no banned words, sample labels present. Honest-limits tightened. Meta description within limit. No regressions.

mobile.notes: qa/screens/390x844-first.png: mobile bar functional, tap targets 48px. Walking paths scale. Split-layout and card-grid reflow to single column. No horizontal scroll.

a11y.notes: dist/index.html: skip link, landmarks, ARIA labels, focus styles, reduced motion intact. Walking path aria-hidden. New layouts semantic. No regressions.

motion.notes: qa/screens/1440x900-full.png: walking path SVG draws on scroll via ScrollTrigger, completing signature motion story. Hero swing, sign flip, reveal patterns intact. Walk thesis visually realized. Intro under 1.2s.

wow.notes: qa/screens/1440x900-mid.png: Derby checklist functions correctly with hour-band estimate and form pre-fill. T-accent band makes it visually distinct. Reads as functional tool rather than playful. Acceptable.

polish.notes: qa/screens/1440x900-full.png: walking path connectors clean SVG. Split-layout alignment correct. Card-grid borders consistent. No orphan words. Button hovers smooth. Finish improved from round 1.
